IN THE HIGH COURT OF FICTIONALAND AT SAMPLEPUR
CRIMINAL MISCELLANEOUS PETITION No. 0456 of 2024
(Petition under Section 528 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023)

Petitioner: Nikhil Placeholder, aged 41, resident of Hilltop Lane, Samplepur.
Respondent No. 1: State of Fictionaland, through the Station House Officer, Police Station Hilltop.
Respondent No. 2: Priya Testcase, resident of Canal Road, Samplepur.

PETITION FOR QUASHING OF FIR No. 0789/2024

MOST RESPECTFULLY SHOWETH:
1. The petitioner and Respondent No. 2 entered into a written agreement dated 15.01.2024 for the supply of building material.
2. A commercial dispute arose over payment, and Respondent No. 2 lodged FIR No. 0789/2024 dated 12.05.2024 at Police Station Hilltop under Sections 318(4) and 316(2) BNS.
3. The petitioner was granted anticipatory bail by the Sessions Court, Samplepur on 20.05.2024.
\f
4. The police filed a charge sheet on 01.08.2024 without considering the documents produced by the petitioner.
5. The dispute is purely civil in nature. The WhatsApp messages exchanged between the parties between February and April 2024 show that payment was only delayed, not refused. Copies of these messages are annexed as Annexure P-3.

GROUNDS:
A. The allegations in the FIR, even if taken at face value, do not disclose the ingredients of cheating or criminal breach of trust.

PRAYER:
It is therefore most respectfully prayed that this Hon'ble Court may be pleased to quash FIR No. 0789/2024 and all proceedings arising from it.

Annexure P-1: Copy of the agreement dated 15.01.2024.
Annexure P-2: Copy of FIR No. 0789/2024.
Annexure P-3: Copies of the WhatsApp messages.

Filed on 02.09.2024 through counsel.
